constraints: Cryptographic gateway trust marker for tenant context: KrakenD injects a signed X-Gateway-Trust header (HMAC over timestamp+path with a platform secret) on every proxied request; the subscription-external partner gateway handlers verify it before honoring tenant_key/channel_key query params (GatewayTrusted), rejecting direct service-port callers attempting tenant spoofing with 403. Entry point: tenantRouteFromGatewayHeaders in services/subscription-external/internal/handler/partner_handler.go; trigger: any /api/external/v1/{tenant_key}/{channel_key}/* request. Acceptance: request through gateway succeeds; same request direct to service port without valid marker gets 403; unit tests for valid/expired/forged markers.
